name: Sore ga Bokura no Ren'ai Seikatsu
original_name: それが僕等の恋愛生活
source: Sore ga Bokura no Renai Seikatsu follows the social struggles of 2nd grade high school student Shingo Yamauchi and subsequent ensuing complicated relationships with his classmates.
translation: 《それが僕等の恋愛生活》讲述高中二年级学生山内伸吾在人际交往中面临的困境，以及此后与同班同学之间逐渐形成的复杂关系。
